moves.sectionTitle: Arbitrary limits, infinity, and maximal power
moves.currentDescription: Infinite non-extensive quantities are impossible because infinity is not a number exceeding every finite number.
moves.lockedProposition: Infinite non-extensive quantities are impossible because infinity is not a number greater than every finite number.
